verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is a coding agent, so this git-workflow story applies. The evidence only covers adjacent capabilities: automating operational tasks such as handling complex rebases and querying pull requests, listing open PRs through a GitHub MCP server, and delegating tasks via @gemini-cli mentions in issues and PRs. None of it explicitly shows the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches or opening PRs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of staging/committing with generated messages, branch creation, PR creation from the CLI, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end git workflow.
